[May 2018]

At a meeting with local business leaders and investors, President Vít Jedlička outlined plans to answer the age-old question - who will build the roads?

The proposed solution would involve an overhaul to Liberland's web service to support complete government transparency. Liberland's website will feature projects in need of crowdfunding, and will publicly publish their list of donors and amounts for each project. A list of businesses incorporated in Liberland will also be publicly available. Estimates and expense reports will also be publicly available for each project, so that the community can judge which programs are doing the most good for the money and promote those services, or propose alternatives as the case may be. Each quarter Liberland will distribute official flyers to display at local businesses showing which projects they've supported over the past year.

The aim is to not only promote businesses and raise money for the community, but to get the community more involved in their volunteer government.

"We believe businesses naturally want to support their community, and that the community naturally wants to support businesses that give a little back. So this is one proposal that we feel might be the right one for the free country of Liberland. We can promote businesses who support their community and let people make informed decisions about where their money is going."

Vít, as he prefers to be called, concluded with a strong message: "This is YOUR country. YOUR home. Go and make it great."
